decision: Exclude the unreferenced utility message-handler definitions from the selected core build and retain them under research.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
The file describes message descriptors used by external utilities including TREE, GRAFTABL, DISKCOMP and DISKCOPY.
No include of msghan.inc is found in retained BIOS, DOS, COMMAND and include source trees or the frozen selected dependency inventory.
The separate msgserv.asm message-service implementation remains in the core tree for its own next ordered review.
limitations: Exclusion applies only to the selected core build; it does not establish that this file is absent or unnecessary when building other DOS utilities.
